name: All cells from human liver dataset
description: All cells (167,598) profiled by a combination of single cell, single nuclei and CITE-Seq from patients undergoing cholecystectomy, gastric bypass or resection due to metastatic colorectal cancer. Corresponds to Figure 4B in publication.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: Annotation of cells in dataset based on prior knowledge.

labels.name: Mono+mono derived cells
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared to rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication). No Canonical marker genes as mixed population - further detail of different populations provided in myeloid cell UMAP.

labels.name: cDC1s
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for these cells compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: cDC2s
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Macrophages
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication). As most of the population are Kupffer cells (KCs), KC specific genes largely define the population however smaller populations of macrophages are also present. Refer to myeloid cell UMAP for more granularity.

labels.name: Mig.cDCs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Plasma cells
labels.rationale: The marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this population compared with the rest of the UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: T cells
labels.rationale: All T cells (not further divided into subsets). Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for these cells compared to rest of UMAP.

labels.name: B cells
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for these cells compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Circulating NK/NKT
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs from this population compared with rest of UMAP from Table S1 in publication. No canonical genes because this is a mixed population. Increased resolution can be found in the lymphoid cell UMAP.

labels.name: Resident NK
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: pDCs
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with the rest of the UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Cholangiocytes
labels.rationale: Marker genes are the top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Basophils
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication). Note some genes are also expressed by Mast cells thus the true nature of this population is still to be determined.

labels.name: Neutrophils
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Endothelial cells
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication). Note this population is predominantly LSECs hence the gene list but smaller populations of portal and central ECs are also contained in this cluster. This is why no canonical marker genes are included. For more resolution refer to CD45- cell UMAP.

labels.name: Hepatocytes
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for this population compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication).

labels.name: Fibroblasts
labels.rationale: Marker genes are top 10 DEGs for these cells compared with rest of UMAP (from Table S1 in publication). Population consists primarily of hepatic stellate cells but other populations of fibroblasts are also included hence why there are no canonical genes given. For more granularity refer to CD45- UMAP.
